verses.gurmukhi: ਮਲਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit_en: malaar mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa

en.bdb: Malaar, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
en.ms: Malar 1st Guru. Ashtapadis.

verses.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
en.ms: There is but One God. By the True Guru's grace, He is obtained.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਖਲੀ ਊਂਡੀ ਜਲੁ ਭਰ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: akhalee uoo(n)ddee jal bhar naal ||

en.bdb: The earth bends under the weight of the water,
en.ms: The entire earth is bent with the weight of the water of the oceans,

verses.gurmukhi: ਡੂਗਰੁ ਊਚਉ ਗੜੁ ਪਾਤਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: ddoogar uoochau gaR paataal ||

en.bdb: the lofty mountains and the caverns of the underworld.
en.ms: the high mountains and the ditches, deep like the under-world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: saagar seetal gur sabadh veechaar ||

en.bdb: Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the oceans become calm.
en.ms: Reflecting on the Guru's word, the oceans are calmed,

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਰਗੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit_en: maarag mukataa haumai maar ||1||

en.bdb: The path of liberation is found by subduing the ego. ||1||
en.ms: self conceit is stilled and the way of salvation is found.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: mai a(n)dhule naavai kee jot ||

en.bdb: I am blind; I seek the Light of the Name.
en.ms: I, the blind one, am illumined by the Lord's Name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ਚਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam adhaar chalaa gur kai bhai bhet ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: I take the Support of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I walk on the path of mystery of the Guru's Fear. ||1||Pause||
en.ms: I have the Name's support alone and walk on the mysterious path in the fear of the Guru. Pause.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਪਾਧਰੁ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sabadhee paadhar jaan ||

en.bdb: Through the Shabad, the Word of the True Guru, the Path is known.
en.ms: Through the True Guru's word, God's way is known.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਤਕੀਐ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur kai takeeaai saachai taan ||

en.bdb: With the Guru's Support, one is blessed with the strength of the True Lord.
en.ms: By the support of the Guru, one is blessed with the power of the True Lord,

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਲਸਿ ਰੂੜੑੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam sam(h)aalas rooR(h)ee baan ||

en.bdb: Dwell on the Naam, and realize the Beauteous Word of His Bani.
en.ms: and one remembers the Name, through the beauteous Gurbani.

verses.gurmukhi: ਥੈਂ ਭਾਵੈ ਦਰੁ ਲਹਸਿ ਪਿਰਾਣਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit_en: thai(n) bhaavai dhar lahas piraan ||2||

en.bdb: If it is Your Will, Lord, You lead me to find Your Door. ||2||
en.ms: If Thou so will, O Lord, then man recognises Thy door.

verses.gurmukhi: ਊਡਾਂ ਬੈਸਾ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਤਾਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: uooddaa(n) baisaa ek liv taar ||

en.bdb: Flying high or sitting down, I am lovingly focused on the One Lord.
en.ms: Flying in the sky or sitting on the ground, my attention is fixed in the One Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur kai sabadh naam aadhaar ||

en.bdb: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I take the Naam as my Suppport.
en.ms: By virtue of the Guru's word, the Lord's Name has become my mainstay.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਡੂੰਗਰੁ ਨ ਊਚੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: naa jal ddoo(n)gar na uoochee dhaar ||

en.bdb: There is no ocean of water, no mountain ranges rising up.
en.ms: For me now there is neither any ocean nor the high range of mountains.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ ਤਹ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
verses.translit_en: nij ghar vaasaa teh mag na chaalanahaar ||3||

en.bdb: I dwell within the home of my own inner being, where there is no path and no one travelling on it. ||3||
en.ms: I abide in my own Home, where there is no path, nor any way-farer.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਬੀਜਉ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jit ghar vaseh toohai bidh jaaneh beejau mahal na jaapai ||

en.bdb: You alone know the way to that House in which You dwell. No one else knows the Mansion of Your Presence.
en.ms: Thou alone know the way to the House, in which Thou dwell, O Lord, no one else can know Thine mansion.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦਬਿਆ ਛਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur baajhahu samajh na hovee sabh jag dhabiaa chhaapai ||

en.bdb: Without the True Guru, there is no understanding. The whole world is buried under its nightmare.
en.ms: Without the True Guru, understanding is attained not. The whole world is weighed down by the night mare of mammon.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਤਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: karan palaav karai bilalaatau bin gur naam na jaapai ||

en.bdb: The mortal tries all sorts of things, and weeps and wails, but without the Guru, he does not know the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
en.ms: Though man may make efforts and lamentations, but without the Guru, he can realise not the Name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: pal pa(n)kaj meh naam chhaddaae je gur sabadh sin(j)aapai ||4||

en.bdb: In the twinkling of an eye, the Naam saves him, if he realizes the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||4||
en.ms: If mortal knows the Guru's word, the Name gets him released in the twinkling of an eye.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਮੂਰਖ ਅੰਧੇ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: eik moorakh a(n)dhe mugadh gavaar ||

en.bdb: Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant.
en.ms: Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: eik satigur kai bhai naam adhaar ||

en.bdb: Some, through fear of the True Guru, take the Support of the Naam.
en.ms: Some there are, who through the Guru's fear lean on the Lord's Name.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੀਠੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰ ॥
verses.translit_en: saachee baanee meeThee a(n)mirat dhaar ||

en.bdb: The True Word of His Bani is sweet, the source of ambrosial nectar.
en.ms: The Guru's word is true, sweet and the stream of Nectar,

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੀਤੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: jin peetee tis mokh dhuaar ||5||

en.bdb: Whoever drinks it in, finds the Door of Salvation. ||5||
en.ms: Whosoever in-drinks it, he obtains the door of emancipation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam bhai bhai ridhai vasaahee gur karanee sach baanee ||

en.bdb: One who, through the love and fear of God, enshrines the Naam within his heart, acts according to the Guru's Instructions and knows the True Bani.
en.ms: Great is the way of life and true the speech of him, who through the Lord's fear and love enshrines His Name within his mind.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: ei(n)dh varasai dharat suhaavee ghaT ghaT jot samaanee ||

en.bdb: When the clouds release their rain, the earth becomes beautiful; God's Light permeates each and every heart.
en.ms: When the Guru-cloud rains, mind's earth becomes beauteous and one sees God's Light pervading all the hearts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਰਿ ਬੀਜਸਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਐਸੀ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaalar beejas dhuramat aaisee nigure kee neesaanee ||

en.bdb: The evil-minded ones plant their seed in the barren soil; such is the sign of those who have no Guru.
en.ms: Such is the insignia of the Guruless evil-minded man, that he sows the seed in the saline-land.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit_en: satigur baajhahu ghor a(n)dhaaraa ddoob mue bin paanee ||6||

en.bdb: Without the True Guru, there is utter darkness; they drown there, even without water. ||6||
en.ms: Without the True Guru, there is appalling darkness and one is drowned to death, even when there is no water.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit_en: jo kichh keeno su prabhoo rajai ||

en.bdb: Whatever God does, is by His Own Will.
en.ms: Whatever the Lord does, that is in His will.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit_en: jo dhur likhiaa su meTanaa na jai ||

en.bdb: That which is pre-ordained cannot be erased.
en.ms: Whatever is predestined, that can be erased not.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬਾਧਾ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit_en: hukame baadhaa kaar kamai ||

en.bdb: Bound to the Hukam of the Lord's Command, the mortal does his deeds.
en.ms: Bound in the Lord's will, man does the deeds,

verses.gurmukhi: ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਾਚੈ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit_en: ek sabadh raachai sach samai ||7||

en.bdb: Permeated by the One Word of the Shabad, the mortal is immersed in Truth. ||7||
en.ms: Permeating in the One Name one merges in the True Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਤਾਲੰ ॥
verses.translit_en: chahu dhis hukam varatai prabh teraa chahu dhis naam pataala(n) ||

en.bdb: Your Command, O God, rules in the four directions; Your Name pervades the four corners of the nether regions as well.
en.ms: Thy will, O Lord, works in the four directions and Thy Name is pervading the four sides of the nether-world as well.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਆਲੰ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabh meh sabadh varatai prabh saachaa karam milai baiaala(n) ||

en.bdb: The True Word of the Shabad is pervading amongst all. By His Grace, the Eternal One unites us with Himself.
en.ms: Amongst all, the True Lord's Name is contained and by His own grace, the Lord is met.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਾਂਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਊਭੌ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaa(n)man maranaa dheesai sir uoobhau khudhiaa nidhraa kaala(n) ||

en.bdb: Birth and death hang over the heads of all beings, along with hunger, sleep and dying.
en.ms: Birth, death, hunger, sleep and exit are seen standing over the heads of all

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
verses.translit_en: naanak naam milai man bhaavai saachee nadhar rasaala(n) ||8||1||4||

en.bdb: The Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind; O True Lord, Source of bliss, please bless me with Your Grace. ||8||1||4||
en.ms: Says Nanak, O Lord, the Home of bliss, by Thine true grace, bless Thou me with Thy Name, which is pleasing to my mind.
